name: Will a whole-home renovation increase my home’s resale value?

mainEntity.name: Will a whole-home renovation increase my home’s resale value?

acceptedAnswer.text: While no project guarantees a specific return, thoughtful whole-home renovations that improve layout, update key spaces, and address deferred maintenance typically make a property more attractive to future buyers.
